questions.q_en: Your Parts page calls AcdS 2.1 the same enzyme with its first fifteen codons recoded. Tell me precisely what that recoding changed, and what it could not change.
questions.q_zh: 你們 Parts 頁說 AcdS 2.1 是同一個酵素，只是前十五個密碼子重新編碼。請精確說明那個重編碼改了什麼，又不可能改到什麼？
questions.a_en: It changed the messenger RNA and nothing about the enzyme. The protein sequence is identical, and we verified that before ordering, so the recoding cannot make the enzyme more stable or more active. What it changes is how open the start of the message is: the first codons after the ATG can base-pair back into the ribosome binding site and occlude the Shine-Dalgarno core. For ACC deaminase, accessibility over the first fifteen bases went from 0.563 in the wild type to 0.773 with the coding sequence recoded, and codon adaptation fell from about 0.85 to 0.75. That is a translation initiation claim, and it is a prediction, not a yield.
questions.a_zh: 它改的是 mRNA，跟酵素本身無關。蛋白質序列完全一樣，這點我們在下訂前就驗證過，所以重編碼不可能讓酵素更穩定或更有活性。它改的是訊息開頭有多開放：ATG 後面的頭幾個密碼子會跟核糖體結合位反向配對，把 Shine-Dalgarno core 遮住。對 ACC deaminase 來說，前十五個鹼基的可及性從野生型的 0.563 提高到重編碼後的 0.773，而密碼子適應度從大約 0.85 掉到 0.75。那是一個關於轉譯起始的主張，而且是預測，不是產量。
questions.trap_en: Saying optimisation improves the protein or helps it survive in the field. Synonymous recoding cannot touch the protein sequence.
questions.trap_zh: 說最佳化讓蛋白質變好或更耐田間環境。同義重編碼不可能動到蛋白質序列。
questions.basis: design check: what a synonymous change can and cannot do

questions.q_en: Your ordered cassettes span codon adaptation index 0.59 to 0.81 against 0.85 to 0.87 for the wild types. You made them worse on that measure. Why?
questions.q_zh: 你們訂的卡匣 codon adaptation index 是 0.59 到 0.81，而野生型是 0.85 到 0.87。在這個指標上你們把它弄差了。為什麼？
kw_en: CAI was a constraint, not the target
kw_zh: CAI 是限制條件不是目標
questions.a_en: Because initiation comes first, and codon adaptation was recorded as a constraint rather than optimised. CAI is roughly how often each codon you used is the one B. subtilis 168 prefers, from the Kazusa usage table. It is a proxy for tRNA supply, not a measurement of it, and it is an average, so it hides where the slow codons sit. Our own constructs make the point: BoPep4 carries a high adaptation index of 0.87 and the lowest start-codon accessibility of anything we built. We traded adaptation for an open start site, most steeply on the two designs that also recode the signal peptide, which fall to 0.59 and 0.63.
questions.a_zh: 因為起始要先過關，而密碼子適應度只是被記錄下來的限制條件，不是最佳化的目標。CAI 大致是說你用的每個密碼子有多常是 B. subtilis 168 偏好的那一個，數字來自 Kazusa 的使用頻率表。它是 tRNA 供給的代理指標，不是量測，而且是平均值，所以會藏住慢密碼子的位置。我們自己的構築就說明了這件事：BoPep4 的適應度高達 0.87，起始密碼子可及性卻是我們做過的所有構築裡最低的。我們是用適應度換開放的起始位點，而把信號肽也一起重編碼的那兩個設計換得最兇，掉到 0.59 和 0.63。
questions.trap_en: Treating a higher CAI as a better design. Note also that our own page attaches 0.87 to BoPep4 in the prose and to the wild type in the table.
questions.trap_zh: 把 CAI 越高當成設計越好。另外要注意，我們自己的頁面在文字裡把 0.87 掛在 BoPep4 上，在表格裡卻是野生型。
questions.basis: the team's own finding that contradicts standard practice

questions.q_en: Why did you spend the optimisation on the first fifteen bases and the Shine-Dalgarno core, rather than on the whole gene?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼你們把最佳化的力氣花在前十五個鹼基和 Shine-Dalgarno core，而不是整個基因？
kw_zh: 核糖體上在未配對的 RNA
questions.a_en: Because the ribosome has to load, and it loads on unpaired RNA. We folded a 236-base window with ViennaRNA 2.7.2 at 37 degrees, covering the recombination site, MF001, a one-base spacer, the 93-base SamyQ signal peptide and the first 90 bases of cargo, and read the mean unpaired probability over the Shine-Dalgarno core and over the first fifteen and thirty bases after the start codon. Ho1, a well-expressed gene in this chassis, gave us a benchmark at 0.681, and we set 0.50 as the minimum acceptable. The whole-gene route was tried in phase two and it made initiation worse by lowering start+15, which is why we stopped there.
questions.a_zh: 因為核糖體必須上得去，而它只能上在沒有配對的 RNA 上。我們用 ViennaRNA 2.7.2 在 37 度折疊一個 236 個鹼基的視窗，涵蓋重組位點、MF001、一個鹼基的 spacer、93 個鹼基的 SamyQ 信號肽，再到貨物基因的前 90 個鹼基，然後讀 Shine-Dalgarno core 以及起始密碼子後前十五和前三十個鹼基的平均未配對機率。Ho1 是這個底盤裡表現良好的基因，給了我們 0.681 這個基準，而我們把 0.50 設為可接受的下限。整個基因一起最佳化的做法在第二階段試過，結果是 start+15 下降、起始變差，所以我們就停在那裡。
questions.trap_en: Claiming you model an elongation ramp. We model initiation only, and recoding the signal peptide would have removed any ramp there.
questions.trap_zh: 說你們有模擬延伸期的 ramp。我們只模擬起始，而把信號肽重編碼反而會把那裡的 ramp 拿掉。
questions.basis: design check: the objective function the team actually ranked on

questions.q_en: Name what synonymous recoding can break. Which of those did you screen for, and what did your screen miss?
questions.q_zh: 請說出同義密碼子重編碼可能破壞什麼。這些當中你們篩了哪些？你們的篩查又漏了什麼？
questions.a_en: It can create a restriction site that breaks Golden Gate, make a Shine-Dalgarno-like sequence inside the gene, remove a deliberate pause, change how fast the message is degraded, or push repeats past what a synthesis house will make. We did screen: of about fifty thousand variants folded per construct we excluded any introducing BsaI, EcoRI, XbaI, SpeI, PstI, NotI or HindIII on either strand across the recoded span plus eight flanking bases, leaving thirty-three to forty-one thousand legal ones. Two misses are ours to own. The scan covered only the recoded window, so it does not certify the whole insert, and it left out BpiI and BsmBI, which are our Level 0 and Level 2 assembly enzymes.
questions.a_zh: 它可能造出破壞 Golden Gate 的限制酶位點、在基因內部做出類似 Shine-Dalgarno 的序列、拿掉刻意的停頓、改變訊息被降解的速度，或讓重複序列超出合成廠做得出來的範圍。我們確實篩了：每個構築折疊大約五萬個變異體，排除任何在重編碼範圍加上兩側八個鹼基內、於任一股上造出 BsaI、EcoRI、XbaI、SpeI、PstI、NotI 或 HindIII 位點的設計，剩下三萬三千到四萬一千個合法變異體。但有兩個漏洞是我們要承認的：掃描只涵蓋重編碼的那個視窗，所以不能保證整段插入；而且它沒有包含 BpiI 和 BsmBI，那正是我們 Level 0 和 Level 2 組裝用的酶。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the screen was complete. A homopolymer run was logged as a warning, not a rejection: three of eight cassettes carry a 6-A run.
questions.trap_zh: 說篩查做得很完整。同聚物只被記成警告、不是排除標準：八個卡匣裡有三個帶 6 個連續 A。
questions.basis: judge pattern: what could this have broken, and did you look

questions.q_en: Suppose you ran your recoded ACC deaminase against the wild-type-codon version, same promoter, same signal peptide, same reactor. Predict the result, and tell me which way you would bet.
questions.q_zh: 假設你們把重編碼的 ACC deaminase 跟野生型密碼子版本對打，同一個啟動子、同一個信號肽、同一台反應器。預測一下結果，並說你會賭哪一邊。
kw_en: I would bet on a small gain
the rebuilt context cut the gain
questions.a_en: I would bet on a small gain or none in protein per OD, and I would say so before running it. Two reasons from our own work. We designed the cassettes behind MF001 and then built them behind RiboJ and RBS0, and recalculating in the element we actually built cut the predicted gain sharply; most of the original improvement came from breaking a pairing that RiboJ prevents anyway. And our own page says the model diagnoses initiation only, not secretion efficiency, signal-recognition targeting or degradation by HtrA and HtrB outside the cell. If it does anything, I would expect a faster rise to detectable enzyme rather than a higher plateau.
questions.a_zh: 我會賭每單位 OD 的蛋白量只有小幅提升或完全沒差，而且我願意在跑之前就這樣說。理由有兩個，都來自我們自己的工作。第一，我們是在 MF001 後面設計這些卡匣，實際組裝卻放在 RiboJ 加 RBS0 後面；用真正建出來的元件重算之後，預測的提升大幅縮小，因為原本的大部分優勢來自打斷一個配對，而 RiboJ 本來就會阻止那個配對。第二，我們自己的頁面寫了，這個模型只診斷起始，不管分泌效率、訊號辨識，也不管細胞外 HtrA 和 HtrB 的降解。如果它真有作用，我預期是比較快到達可偵測的酵素量，而不是平台值變高。
questions.trap_en: Predicting a large gain. Our own text says a higher start+15 identifies a construct worth testing and does not predict yield.
questions.trap_zh: 預測會有大幅提升。我們自己的文字就說，start+15 較高只表示這個構築值得測試，不預測產量。
questions.basis: reasoning: predict an experiment the team never ran, from what they do know

questions.q_en: Which of your sequence choices has ever been tested against its alternative in the lab?
questions.q_zh: 你們的序列選擇裡，有哪一個真的在實驗室裡跟它的替代方案比過？
kw_en: no CSN construct beside the optimised one
control read in the same range
correction factor with nothing to correct
kw_zh: 沒有 CSN 構築陪跑
questions.a_en: Properly, none of them. We designed for it twice and have not closed either. The anti-His ELISA was built to compare the two gene sequences, but no CSN construct was assayed beside the recoded one, so the fold difference cannot be calculated and the correction factor of 2.66 we took from the literature has nothing yet to correct. The two constructs also differ in both the signal peptide and the gene version, so even run together they confound two variables. One panel did put BoPep4 against its two recodings, and the untransformed WB800 control read 5.5 and 4.6 micrograms per millilitre, the same range as four of six constructs, so nothing in it can be attributed to expression.
questions.a_zh: 嚴格講，一個都沒有。我們設計了兩次，兩次都還沒收尾。anti-His ELISA 本來就是為了比較兩個基因序列而設計的，但沒有任何 CSN 構築跟重編碼版本一起量，所以倍數差算不出來，而我們從文獻拿來的 2.66 修正係數目前沒有東西可以修正。那兩個構築還同時差在信號肽和基因版本，所以即使一起跑也混了兩個變數。有一組 panel 確實把 BoPep4 跟它的兩個重編碼版本放在一起，但未轉型的 WB800 對照讀到每毫升 5.5 和 4.6 微克，跟六個構築裡的四個同一個範圍，所以裡面沒有任何差異能歸因於表達。
questions.trap_en: Presenting the ELISA concentrations as the codon comparison. They quantify one construct; they do not compare two gene sequences.
questions.trap_zh: 把 ELISA 的濃度當成密碼子比較。那些數字只定量了一個構築，沒有比較兩個基因序列。
questions.basis: team's own gap: the comparison the order set was designed for is still owed an assay

questions.q_en: If you could only do one of three things to raise titre, codon optimisation, a stronger promoter or a better signal peptide, which one and why?
questions.q_zh: 如果要提高產量，密碼子最佳化、更強的啟動子、更好的信號肽，你只能做一件，你選哪一個？為什麼？
kw_en: light moved it a few percent
kw_zh: SamyQ 淨值是 Csn 的 2.19 倍
questions.a_en: Signal peptide. It is the only one of the three that has moved a number in our hands. With PLP added, SamyQ reached 89.7 nanomoles of product against 73.4 for Csn, which is 2.19 times the net over the host baseline, although that is one well each and the two also differ in gene version. The literature says the best signal peptide is cargo-specific and cannot be predicted, so it has to be screened, and that is a week. The promoter is not our problem: under green against red light our ELISA reads 12.9 against 11.8 micrograms per millilitre, so light-dependent regulation is still unverified and more transcription is not the lever.
questions.a_zh: 信號肽。三個裡面只有它在我們手上真的動過數字。加了 PLP 之後，SamyQ 做出 89.7 奈莫耳產物，Csn 是 73.4，扣掉宿主基線後是 2.19 倍；不過各只有一個孔，而且兩者的基因版本也不同。文獻說最好的信號肽跟貨物有關、沒辦法預測，所以只能篩，而篩一輪大概一週。啟動子不是我們的問題：綠光對紅光，我們的 ELISA 讀到每毫升 12.9 對 11.8 微克，所以光控調節還沒被證實，而轉錄更多不是那根槓桿。
questions.trap_en: Choosing the promoter. Our own results say protein expression did not consistently increase with green light, so reliable light control is unverified.
questions.trap_zh: 選啟動子。我們自己的結果說蛋白表達並沒有隨綠光穩定上升，所以可靠的光控還沒被證實。
questions.basis: judge pattern: force a single prioritised intervention with a reason

questions.q_en: Assume the codons are fine. What else is holding your yield down, and in what order would you bet on them?
questions.q_zh: 假設密碼子已經沒問題了。還有什麼在壓住你們的產量？你會依什麼順序下注？
kw_zh: 分泌與 SRP 標的辨識
細胞外的 HtrA 與 HtrB
questions.a_en: Our own limits section lists them, and I would bet in that order. Secretion first: signal-recognition targeting and co-translational export, which the initiation model says nothing about. Then degradation outside the cell by HtrA and HtrB, which our page flags as worse for a disordered protein like LEA14. Then folding, and we have a result there: AmilCP never coloured the medium, and the explanation we accept is that secreted protein crosses the membrane unfolded and has to fold outside, which a beta-barrel chromoprotein cannot do fast enough. Inclusion bodies are not our evidence; the 2 August fractionation blot put ACC deaminase in the supernatant and left both pellet lanes blank.
questions.a_zh: 我們自己的「限制」那一節就列出來了，我也會照那個順序下注。第一是分泌：訊號辨識的標的導向和共轉譯輸出，而起始模型對這些完全沒有話說。第二是細胞外的 HtrA 和 HtrB 降解，我們頁面特別註明這對像 LEA14 這種無序蛋白更嚴重。第三是摺疊，而這裡我們有結果：AmilCP 從來沒讓培養液出現顏色，我們接受的解釋是分泌的蛋白是以未摺疊狀態穿過膜、必須在外面才摺疊，而 beta-barrel 色蛋白來不及。包涵體不是我們的證據；8 月 2 日的分層墨點把 ACC deaminase 放在上清液，兩個沉澱道都是空的。
questions.trap_en: Reciting a textbook list. Name the evidence in our own records for each one, and say which we cannot support.
questions.trap_zh: 背一串教科書清單。每一項都要講出我們自己記錄裡的證據，並說出哪些我們沒辦法支持。
questions.basis: boundary: what the codon model explicitly does not cover

questions.q_en: Your pages mix silent recoding with real amino-acid changes. Tell me which is which, and what evidence each kind owes us.
questions.q_zh: 你們的頁面把沉默的重編碼和真正改胺基酸的變化混在一起。請說明哪個是哪個，以及每一類各欠我們什麼證據。
kw_zh: 沉默的要交出更多蛋白
錯義的要交出每毫克活性
questions.a_en: The 2.1 and 2.2 cargoes are silent: same protein, so what they owe is more protein, not proof of function. A change that alters the protein owes activity on the same material the protein was quantified on, so we can quote activity per milligram. We have an example of why care matters. A pairwise alignment against the crystal's organism found position 156 is tyrosine there and phenylalanine in ours, so a substitution our design document called Y156C does not exist in our protein, and three docking runs had already gone out on the wrong background. The enzyme variants were ranked by predicted stability, and that method's blind-test error is wider than most of our differences.
questions.a_zh: 2.1 和 2.2 這些貨物序列是沉默的：蛋白質一樣，所以它們要交出的是更多蛋白，不是功能的證明。會改到蛋白質的那些變化標準不一樣，它們欠的是在同一份已定量蛋白的樣品上做的活性量測，這樣我們才能講每毫克的活性。我們有一個例子說明為什麼要小心：跟晶體那個物種做兩兩比對後發現，位置 156 在晶體裡是 tyrosine，在我們的構築裡是 phenylalanine，所以設計文件叫 Y156C 的那個突變在我們的蛋白裡根本不存在，而那時已經有三次 docking 用錯的背景送出去了。酵素變異體我們是用預測的穩定性排序，而那個方法的盲測誤差比我們大部分的差異還大。
questions.trap_en: Treating recoded and mutated parts as the same kind of modification. One owes titre, the other owes activity, and no enzyme variant reached an order.
questions.trap_zh: 把重編碼和突變當成同一類修改。一個欠產量、一個欠活性，而且沒有任何酵素變異體真的下訂。
questions.basis: design check: what evidence each class of sequence change requires

questions.q_en: Codon optimisation is a button on every synthesis vendor's website. What did yours add?
questions.q_zh: 密碼子最佳化在每家合成廠網站上都是一個按鈕。你們自己做的多了什麼？
kw_en: v2 and v3 ordered as a pair
kw_zh: v2 與 v3 成對訂購
questions.a_en: A vendor tool maximises codon adaptation and does not touch the signal peptide. We did three things it would not. We made start-region accessibility the objective and adaptation only a constraint, which is why our ordered set sits below wild type there. We opened SamyQ codons two to thirty-one, the stretch folding back onto the start site, and for ACC deaminase that lifted accessibility further than editing the cargo alone. And we ordered the comparison rather than the winner: ACC deaminase and AmilCP each went out as a cargo-only and a signal-peptide-edited version, so the question is testable. We also ran a published low-GC heuristic as a control, and for LEA14 it came out worse than wild type.
questions.a_zh: 廠商的工具是把密碼子適應度拚到最高，而且不會動信號肽。我們做了三件它不會做的事。第一，我們把起始區可及性當成目標，適應度只當限制條件，這也是為什麼我們訂的那一套在適應度上低於野生型。第二，我們把 SamyQ 的密碼子 2 到 31 開放可改，那正是折回去蓋住起始位點的那一段；對 ACC deaminase 來說，這比只改貨物基因把可及性拉得更高。第三，我們訂的是「比較」而不只是贏家：ACC deaminase 和 AmilCP 各做了一個只改貨物、一個連信號肽一起改的版本，所以這個問題是可以測的。我們也把一篇文獻的低 GC 經驗法則當對照跑，而對 LEA14 它比野生型更差。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the pipeline is novel in general. The new parts are the objective, the editable signal peptide and the paired order, and none is validated yet.
questions.trap_zh: 籠統地說這個流程很新。新的部分是目標函數、可編輯的信號肽，以及成對訂購，而且都還沒被驗證。
questions.basis: positioning: what a team adds over a vendor's default optimiser
